component.name: Aaina Desktop
component.summary: Model photos of your products, made on your computer

description.p: Add a photo of what you sell, pick a studio model, poses and a scene, and get model photos for your shop. Aaina Desktop is free and open source, and everything you make is kept on your computer.
Photos are made with your own OpenAI account, about $0.05 a photo, billed by OpenAI. There is no account with Aaina and no subscription. The app shows the rough cost before anything is sent.

ul.li: Photos on a model, in up to six poses and the scene you choose
Make again, Fix something and Other colours
Your own models, poses and scenes
Saves JPEG or PNG in marketplace shapes, marked as AI-made inside the file

description.p: Only what a photo needs is sent to OpenAI. The app has no account, no ads and no tracking.

screenshot.caption: Your finished photos, ready to save
Pick a studio model for your product

description.p: After restoring a backup, every restored photo is treated as being in your own photos folder, whatever the backup says, and deleting a photo only ever removes that one picture file. A backup from someone else can't lead to other files being deleted.

The app can only use its own folders, your photos folder (Pictures/Aaina), Downloads, and files or folders you choose or drag onto the window. It no longer has access to your whole home folder. A folder you choose stays allowed after a restart.
No more sideways scrolling when the window is small on Windows.
Staying signed in with ChatGPT works on Windows, and a keyring that can't be used is explained in plain words.
